basis: dep = share of China-bound exports that cannot avoid Hormuz. East-West pipeline Abqaiq-Yanbu: 5 mb/d nominal, temporarily 7 mb/d, of which ~5 mb/d available for exports (EIA). EIA STEO Oct 2026: the pipeline carried >5 mb/d via Yanbu after the March 2026 closure, then attacks in Sep 2026 temporarily halted it (partial restart 22 Sep) and Yanbu loadings fell by about half in August - dependence is time-varying, not captured by a static parameter. Gas assumed equal to crude (small volumes).
